cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

mechanism: A coaches its former tennis pupil to concede one line call while explicitly leaving the match result intact.
confusable: Not reopening the contest or seeking a rematch: A separates the disputed fact from overall victory and asks only for that word.
comparison: Single ball call versus single restaurant credit within a holiday.
